import collections
import numpy as np
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt

def task_func(data_dict):
    if not data_dict:
        return None, "The distribution is uniform."

    categories = list(data_dict.keys())
    counts = np.asarray(list(data_dict.values()), dtype=float)

    avg_count = float(np.mean(counts))
    is_uniform = bool(np.all(np.abs(counts - avg_count) <= 1e-5))

    unique_count_num = len(set(counts.tolist()))
    bins = min(10, unique_count_num)

    fig, ax = plt.subplots()
    ax.hist(counts, bins=bins)

    if len(categories) == 1:
        tick_positions = [counts[0]]
    else:
        xmin, xmax = ax.get_xlim()
        tick_positions = np.linspace(xmin, xmax, num=len(categories))

    ax.set_xticks(tick_positions)
    ax.set_xticklabels(categories, rotation=45, ha="right")

    message = "The distribution is uniform." if is_uniform else "The distribution is not uniform."
    return ax, message
